links.comparator_used: Monitoring model performance (AUC, Brier score) over the temporal validation period
links.outcome: Detection of data distribution shifts and data quality issues not visible in performance metrics
links.effect: Model performance stayed stable (AUC 0.82, Brier score 0.158). Univariate monitoring detected a significant shift in respiratory rate from January 2022, mainly at one hospital. PCA reconstruction error flagged three non-sequential months, with the highest in March 2021. Two alerts were data entry errors (saturation, heart rate) and one was an unusually long length of stay.
links.tradeoff: Flagged alerts needed investigation, and most were data quality problems or outliers rather than clinically meaningful drift. The study did not show any performance degradation.
links.quote: By tracking both model performance and data drift, this study identified shifts in data distributions and data quality issues in a clinical AI model.
